query: How can I check the application status of my REP application?
reference_answer: You can enquire the details of your REP by clicking the "Check Application Status" function in the e-Service.
context:
[Document 1]
You can enquire the details of your REP by clicking the "Check Application Status" function in the e-Service.

[Document 2]
You may check the status of your online application or retrieve your application reference number by logging in to MyICA.For hardcopy applications, you may log in to our e-Service.

[Document 3]
All REP renewal applications are being carefully assessed, taking into consideration all relevant factors, before a decision is made. If there are fresh facts and circumstances to support your request for a longer REP validity, you may furnish them to us for consideration at your next REP renewal.

[Document 4]
You may check your past top-up applications by logging in to the CPF website and checking under “my cpf” > “Activities”.

[Document 5]
You may check the validity of the Re-entry Permit (REP) held by the person alongside a valid Identity Card (IC) or Digital IC (if available).
answer: To check the application status of your REP, click the "Check Application Status" function in the e-Service. [Document 1] Additionally, for online applications, log in to MyICA. For hardcopy applications, use the e-Service. [Document 1] & [Document 2]
